moduleEvidence.title: Modern Japanese 2a: Production
entry:
Students must pass Modern Japanese 1b to participate in Modern Japanese 2a.
Please note that you must pass both Modern Japanese 2a: Production and Teksten in order to proceed to Modern Japanese 2b & 2c in Semester 2, which are combined courses consisting of both production and teksten components.

moduleEvidence.title: Modern Japanese 2a: Texts
entry:
Deze cursus is verplicht voor hoofdvakstudenten Japanstudies. Er is daarnaast beperkt plek voor studenten van andere opleidingen. Studenten dienen de cursus **Modern Japans 1b** met goed gevolg afgesloten te hebben om deel te mogen nemen aan deze cursus.
 
Studenten die in 2024-2025 of eerder begonnen zijn met de opleiding Japanstudies, dienen de cursus **Teksten 1b** met goed gevolg afgesloten te hebben om deel te mogen nemen aan deze cursus.

moduleEvidence.title: Modern Japanese 2b
entry:
Deze cursus is verplicht voor hoofdvakstudenten Japanstudies. Er is daarnaast beperkt plek voor studenten van andere opleidingen.

Studenten dienen de vakken \*Modern Japans 2a: Teksten\* en \*Modern Japans 2a: Productie\* met goed gevolg afgesloten te hebben om deel te mogen nemen aan deze cursus.

Dit vak vindt alleen plaats in blok iii en wordt in blok iv vervolgd met het vak \*Modern Japans 2c\* (studenten die in blok iv naar Japan gaan, volgen een alternatief programma).

moduleEvidence.title: HUM Seminar Literature and Visual Media
entry:
This course is only accessible for BA Japanstudies students. Students must have successfully completed all courses from BA1, 10 EC in BA2 seminars and the course *Texts IIb*.

Admission to this seminar happens only through [this application form](https://fd24.formdesk.com/universiteitleiden/JSBA3TS1).

moduleEvidence.title: Practising Japanese Studies
entry: This course is only accessible for BA Japanstudies students. Students must have successfully completed 10 EC in BA2 seminars and the courses *Production IIb* and *Production IIc* (or the study abroad programme in Japan: ‘Japanverblijf’).

moduleEvidence.title: Graduation Seminar Japanstudies
entry: Students must have passed:* All first year courses (propedeuse)* 10 EC in BA2 seminars* BA2 Texts IIb* BA2 Production IIb* BA2 Production IIc (or BA2 Study Abroad)In addition students must have fulfilled the participation element of a BA3 seminar in the first semester.

moduleEvidence.title: BA Thesis
entry: Studenten moeten onderstaande componenten hebben afgerond:* Alle vakken uit het eerste jaar (de propedeuse)* 10 EC aan BA2 seminars* BA2 Teksten IIb* BA2 Productie IIb* BA2 Productie IIc (of BA2 Studieverblijf Japan)Daarnaast moeten studenten hebben voldaan aan de participatie eis van het BA3 seminar in het eerste semester.

identity: The current Leiden catalogue confirms an ordinary 180 EC degree with disciplinary seminar choices. This example uses the Leiden-based second-year option and the thesis pathway. In year two there are 20 EC of required study and 40 EC of restricted choices: 10 EC semester-one seminar, 5 EC semester-two seminar, 5 EC restricted option, 5 EC shared Asian studies, and a 15 EC Leiden or study-abroad option. The Leiden option combines Modern Japanese 2c and a distinct shared Asian studies course. Year three contains 15 EC of specialist choices, a 5 EC Graduation Seminar and 10 EC thesis, and 30 EC open study. The alternative external research project is 30 EC and changes the open allocation; it is not included. Year-one mentorship carries zero credit. Non-curricular proficiency preparation is excluded. Current annual module descriptions establish the language and research gates; the archive is corroborating context. The current programme-specific regulation URL returned an access page.

officialAlternative.finding: The dated prior guide corroborates the Leiden versus Japan choice and third-year open structure. Current group and module records, rather than the dated archive, establish the displayed 2026–2027 credit allocations and entry requirements. The two blocked URLs returned access HTML. The alternative current module records establish the necessary facts without a guessed regulation.

progression: The 15 EC 1a requires kana literacy. A pass in 1a gates 1b, and 1b gates both 2a courses. Annual 5692VMJAPY explicitly identifies both current 2b and 2c as combined production and text courses, supporting the older Texts/Production terminology in later entries. Both 2a courses gate 2b and 2c; 2b is block 3 and 2c continues it in block 4. Selected BA2 seminars supply 15 EC. The BA3 literature seminar requires first year, 10 EC of BA2 seminars and the IIb texts component. Practising Japanese Studies requires 10 EC of BA2 seminars and the IIb and IIc production components on the Leiden route. The Graduation Seminar and thesis require first year, 10 EC of BA2 seminars, IIb texts and production and IIc production, plus participation in the BA3 seminar. The graduation seminar requires thesis preparatory work and Japanese source reading. The thesis uses Japanese-language sources and normally is written in Dutch or English. English delivery is documented for several subject modules; language study is not equivalent to blanket Japanese-medium instruction. Shared choices Korean History until 1876 (S1) and Modern Korean History (S2) use distinct codes. The 30 EC external project and 15 EC remaining electives are a different configuration, not the displayed thesis route.
